repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-20T23:02Z · On the seat's decision card 「浅色主题里「删除」等红色文字，要不要调深到无障碍达标？」, the maintainer chose 「只调深文字到深红」 (option A of three) at 2026-11-20T23:02:22Z. The other two options were 「只调深文字到中红」 and 「保持现状」.

Recorded meaning for item 3:
- The light theme gets its own `--destructive-text` value, red-700 (`#b91c1c`). Contrast is 6.47:1 on white, 5.91:1 on the hover background and 5.68:1 on a 10% red fill.
- `--text-color-destructive` then reads it.
- `--destructive`, the brand red used for button and badge fills, does not change.
- Set it in all three CSS copies: `ui/packages/components/src/index.css`, `runner/src/index.css` and `apps/console/src/index.css`.
- The tenant theme engine maps a custom error colour only to `--destructive` (`core/src/theme/ThemeEngine.ts:98`). It must also derive the text value, so that a tenant's custom red still drives red text.
- Update the screenshot baselines.

Out of scope, recorded only: white text on the destructive button fill is 3.59:1, also under 4.5:1. Fixing that would change the brand red itself, and the maintainer did not rule on it.

Item 3 now rides the same PR as items 1–2, which then carries `Fixes #35911`.

Claim amendment to comment 7052347108 · 2026-11-20T23:03Z · The maintainer ruled item 3 (record 7052747252), so the claim widens to all three items. The PR carries `Fixes #35911` instead of `Refs #35911 (items 1-2)`.

File surface (added):
- the light-theme `--destructive-text` line in the four shipped theme blocks: `ui/packages/components/src/index.css`, `ui/apps/console/src/index.css`, `ui/packages/runner/src/index.css` and the `ui/packages/cli` app-generator template;
- the tenant error-colour mapping in `ThemeEngine.ts`, which also derives the text value;
- the screenshot baselines.

Everything else in the claim stands.
